meta.title: LiTT - Legal AI Platform
meta.description: AI-powered legal document analysis and contract review platform.

mentorPanel.title: Mentor panel
mentorPanel.intro: Supervise one pupil at a time. Nothing here compares or ranks your pupils, and only you and each pupil see their data.
mentorPanel.notMentor: You are not a mentor in any organization. An owner or an admin of the organization designates mentors.
mentorPanel.noPupils: You have no pupils here yet. Add them in Training, under My pupils.
mentorPanel.pendingReview: {count, plural, =0 {No work waiting for review} one {# work waiting for review} other {# works waiting for review}}
mentorPanel.passInForce: Urgency pass in force until {end, date, medium} {end, time, short}
mentorPanel.lastWork: Last work: {date, date, medium} {date, time, short}

review.generatedWith: Generated with {model} on {date, date, medium} {date, time, short}
review.reviewedOn: Reviewed on {date, date, medium} {date, time, short}
review.failed: The review could not be generated. You can try again.

works.intro: Each work is a conversation with turn notes. The review shows four things; what was left unverified is computed, not generated.
works.empty: This pupil has no work with turn notes yet.
works.withoutAccess: {count, plural, one {# work is in a matter you cannot open.} other {# works are in matters you cannot open.}} The owner of the matter can give you access.
works.meta: {surface} · {notes, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}} · {date, date, medium} {date, time, short}
works.newWork: There is new work since this review.
works.heldDrafts: {count, plural, one {# sealed draft still waits for approval; approve it from its document.} other {# sealed drafts still wait for approval; approve them from each document.}}
works.keyRequired: To generate reviews and defense questions you need an AI key you can use in this organization. There is no fallback to another key. You can still record a defense without AI.

codes.inProgress: A review of this work is already being generated. Wait a moment and reload.
codes.credentialUnavailable: The key this review used is no longer available to you. Choose another key and try again.
codes.keyRequired: You need an AI key you can use in this organization.

defenses.intro: Five questions on the pupil's own reasoning, one of them a change of facts. The outcome is recorded once; to correct it, hold a new defense.
defenses.practiceFromWork: The practice area of the work's matter
defenses.createdOn: Created on {date, date, medium} {date, time, short}
defenses.questionsFailed: The questions could not be generated. You can try again, or record the outcome without them.
defenses.question: Question {number}

reason.cambio_de_hechos_no_resuelto: Did not resolve the change of facts

defenses.confirmMessage: {outcome}: {reason}. It is recorded once and cannot be changed; to correct it, hold a new defense.

codes.alreadyRecorded: This defense already has an outcome. Reload to see it.

passes.intro: A pass lifts “Your turn first” for this pupil in one matter, for a limited time. Their drafts stay sealed until approved, and the pass does not apply in Word.
passes.noProjects: You have no matters in this organization
passes.inForce: In force until {end, date, medium} {end, time, short}
passes.ended: Ended on {end, date, medium} {end, time, short}
passes.revoked: Revoked on {date, date, medium} {date, time, short}
passes.confirmMessage: From the next turn, the pupil writes their own approach again in {project}.

codes.duplicate: This pupil already has a pass in force in that matter ending at the same time.
codes.limit: This pupil already has the most passes in force allowed. Revoke one first.
codes.pupilNoAccess: The pupil cannot open that matter, so the pass would not apply.
codes.invalid: Check the matter, the duration and the reason.

promotion.intro: LiTT proposes; you decide. A proposal rests only on this pupil's approved defenses and reviewed works since their stage last changed.
promotion.empty: This pupil has no stage to promote.

blocked.not_approved_after: A defense was not approved after the last approved one.
blocked.general_stage_remains: Their stage for every practice area would still apply, so removing this one would not make them a lawyer in it.

promotion.confirmMessage: {practice}: from {from} to {to}. You can change the stage again later in Training.

codes.notProposed: This proposal no longer holds. Reload to see the current evidence.

mentorSeesMe.title: What my mentor sees of me
mentorSeesMe.intro: The same reviews, defenses and passes your mentor sees here. Nothing more, nothing less.
mentorSeesMe.scheduled: A defense is scheduled. You will see its questions and note once the outcome is recorded.
